App.title: Sound Design & Music
App.subtitle: I create memorable sound experiences.
App.aboutMe:
Greissy is a sound designer and musician specializing in transforming ideas into sound experiences and pieces for film, video games, and advertising. Her work is characterized by a creative and sensitive approach focused on creating immersive sound experiences with a distinct identity and the ability to connect with audiences.

She holds a degree in Sound Creation and training in Sound and Recording, which allows her to develop an interdisciplinary perspective that combines art, technology, and storytelling to create memorable soundscapes. Her work focuses primarily on sound design for video games, interactive environments, and audiovisual productions, guided by an aesthetic approach that balances emotion, functionality, and narrative depth.

She works with specialized tools such as Reaper and iZotope, as well as a variety of plugins for audio editing, mixing, and mastering. In addition, she complements her sound work with proficiency in visual tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Krita, among others, expanding her possibilities within creative and audiovisual processes.

Her musical training began at an early age, allowing her to explore different instruments and later develop professionally as a pianist and mandolin player. She has performed with various ensembles and orchestras, an experience that has enriched her understanding of music and collaborative work.

Currently, she works as a Technical Production Assistant and Sound and Recording Operator at Corear, an orchestra dedicated to performing video game music. She is also part of the First Mandolin section in a new project aimed at promoting and developing orchestral mandolin ensembles in the city of Buenos Aires, Argentina.

UP.TCS1:
This project stands out for its creation of a sound design that evokes an emotional atmosphere, complemented by images that align with the narrative. It is inspired by the poem “Hombre preso que mira a su hijo” by Mario Benedetti, from which several excerpts are used alongside a soundtrack and sound effects, representing the emotional and historical concept conveyed through footage captured at the Parque de la Memoria and sections of the feature film La Noche de los Lápices by Héctor Olivera.

 **Group project – 2022** 

_Main roles: sound design, editing and montage, scriptwriting, performance as mandolin player, filming of original shots, mixing and mastering._
UP.TCS5:
First approach to the creation, sound design and music scoring of a video game.In this project, immersive audio is explored for interactive and virtual reality content,non-linear audio, non-linear music, development of virtual and immersive spaces, and the spatialization of audio in virtual and immersive 3D exploration environments. Implementing the use of tools such as Unity and Wwise. It is inspired by a Venezuelan legend known as El Silbón, within the horror genre.

 **Individual project – 2024**
UP.PM2:
This project covered resources, tools, and skills for producing an online musical event under three main themes: Britpop, Surrealism, and Solidarity. Inspired by the album Yellow Submarine by The Beatles, the aim was to connect music with surrealist art. The event was framed as a fundraising and support initiative for the Brincar Foundation, which provides guidance and support for people within the autism spectrum.

 **Group project – 2023** 

 _Main roles: producer, coordinator, screenwriter, photographer, editor, co-art director, and general director._
UP.Anim1:
Integrated project developed within the Animation I course. The project involved designing a character and its environment based on the song "Yerbatero" by Juanes, followed by the creation of a rhythmic animation with a cohesive narrative. Conceptually, the project combines the connotations of the term _yerbatero_: on one hand, its meaning in Colombia, linked to healing knowledge and mysticism; and on the other, its significance in Argentina, associated with the preparation of yerba mate. The sound design was also developed to actively enhance and support the narrative.

**Individual Project – 2023**
UP.Anim2:
This proposal focuses on rebranding by creating an emotional differential that reconnects the brand with a young audience, incorporating elements present in their current modes of entertainment. The work includes the variation and animation of the event logo, the creation of a sound logo, music scoring, and sound design. Additionally, an animated webtoon was developed in After Effects, complemented with audiovisual material generated using artificial intelligence tools. 

 **Individual project – 2025**
